summary: Backend-only retest of L02 LN-022-T03 (correction of ISSUED SO via amendment credit/debit note + journal, double-credit guard). Existing suites test_l02_ln022_t03_amendment_note.py + _extended.py: 15/15 pass. New edge suite test_l02_ln022_t03_amendment_note_edge.py (9 tests): 6 pass, 3 fail = 3 real bugs. Combined 21/24. VERIFIED WORKING: same target price twice -> 2nd preview/propose 400 'sudah dikoreksi oleh nota sebelumnya', total CN = one-time delta; two-step 0.9->0.8 credits only the increment, changes[0].from = previous to, SO grand_total unchanged; pending note on same product/field -> preview & propose 400 'menunggu persetujuan' (a different field on the same line is allowed); reject frees the key; stale pending note (its 'from' differs from effective value) -> approve 400 'sudah berubah', stays pending_approval, no CN; line discount_percent and order_discount_percent notes -> credit_note, balanced JE, repeat blocked, order-level pending clash blocked; exactly 1 JE per CN (amendment_credit_note), AR via payments method credit_note, remainder to store credit, double approve 400 and idempotent; un-issued (reserved) order still uses re_derive. FAILURES: (1) race on concurrent propose, (2) over-credit across fields when 2 pending notes on interacting fields are approved one after the other, (3) a credit note after an UNBILLED debit note cuts AR by the debit amount.

critical.issue: Over-credit across fields. Two pending notes on the SAME line but different fields (price x0.9 and discount_percent 10) are both allowed, because the clash key is (product_id, field). Each note's delta is frozen at propose time against the same baseline. _assert_note_still_valid only checks each change's own 'from', so both approvals pass. Repro on SO 2,166,120: credited 433,224 but the real reduction (price 0.9 + 10% discount) is 411,562.8, i.e. 21,661.2 too much. order_discount_percent combined with any line field, and line price combined with discount_percent, are affected the same way.

_note_baseline counts an applied debit_note as effective value, but debit notes are never billed (awaiting_billing_rule, no JE, AR unchanged). Repro: DN price x1.2, then CN back to the original price gives a CN of 433,224 with ar_applied=433,224 and a JE Cr 1-1200 433,224. The receivable and revenue fall below the original invoice even though the net price change is 0. Either exclude debit notes in awaiting_billing_rule from the baseline, or net the CN against the open DN (cancel/offset the DN) instead of reducing AR.

TOCTOU: the pending clash check in preview() and the insert in propose() are not atomic. 4 parallel identical proposals created 2-3 pending_approval amendments for the same (product, price) key. The stale guard still stops a 2nd CN when approving (total credited stayed one-time), but duplicate pending docs and approver notifications pile up. Fix: unique partial index or a per-doc lock (e.g. findOneAndUpdate on sales_orders.note_lock / a doc_amendments partial unique index on doc_id+key while pending).

minor.issue: Status 'approved' is treated as pending. If _apply_note raises after decide() sets status=approved, that key stays locked forever and there is no retry or rollback path.
The credit-note payment row is labelled '<CN number> (kasus keuangan)' (a finance-case label). Pass a proper label for amendment credit notes.
Not atomic: the CN is inserted with status issued, then the AR payment, JE and store credit are written. A failure in between leaves a CN 'issued' with a partial settlement and no reconciliation job.

action_items: Fix the cross-field over-credit. Options: (a) clash key = (doc_id) for note methods, so only one pending note per order at a time; or (b) at approve time recompute the delta from the current effective baseline (re-run preview with the stored 'to' values), store the new impact/before/after, and reject if it differs from the proposed delta beyond tolerance.
Exclude unbilled debit notes (billing_status awaiting_billing_rule) from _note_baseline, or offset a later CN against the open DN, so AR/revenue are never reduced for amounts that were never billed.
Make the pending-note uniqueness atomic (lock or unique index) so concurrent proposals cannot create duplicate pending notes.
Optional: handle the stuck 'approved' status, fix the CN payment label, and add a reconciliation path for half-settled CNs.
critical_code_review_comments: amendment_service.py is 1,020 lines, above the 700-line guideline. Split the note logic (_note_baseline, _apply_note, _settle_credit_note, _assert_note_still_valid) into an amendment_note_service module.

_assert_note_still_valid compares 'from' per field only. It should validate the whole effective baseline (or the recomputed delta), because the money impact depends on price, discount and order discount together.

Test fixtures were fragile: test_l02_ln022_t03_amendment_note.py had no pre-cleanup. A crashed run left so_TEST_l022t03 behind and the next run failed with E11000 uq_number (I reproduced this at the start). Notification cleanup used the wrong field (ref_id instead of ref/action_id), which left 72 amendment_approval notifications in the DB. Fixed in the tests and the leftovers were deleted.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Tests clone a done SO (ent_kanda, so_dea8053010e9, grand_total 2,166,120, PPN 0) into so_TEST_l022t03e_* and delete everything afterwards: SOs, credit_notes, doc_amendments, journal_entries, store_credit_ledger, doc_refs, notifications (ref/action_id), and the entity config_values sales.allow_item_discount/allow_order_discount (temporarily enabled for ent_kanda, then set back to false and the docs deleted). A DB scan after the run found 0 leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend; set -a; . ./.env; set +a; export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL ../frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2-); python -m pytest tests/test_l02_ln022_t03_amendment_note*.py -n0 -p no:cacheprovider. The 3 failing edge tests (concurrent, cross_field, unbilled_debit_note_then_credit_note) are the bug repros and should pass once fixed. Line/order discounts are disabled by default (sales.allow_*_discount=false), so the edge suite's disc_on fixture enables them per entity. A 10% change on the source SO is over 5% and goes to pending_approval (manager approves; dual_control is on).
rca of the issue: Over-credit: notes on a line are keyed per field, but one money delta depends on several fields (price x (1-disc) x (1-order_disc)). Both pending deltas are computed against the same pre-note baseline, so approving both counts the interaction term (price drop x discount) twice: 44000x0.1x49.23x0.1 = 21,661.2, which matches the observed over-credit exactly. DN->CN: an applied DN changes the effective baseline although nothing was billed, so the later CN reverses an amount that was never booked to AR. Race: check-then-insert without a lock.
